request: Write an ADR from this thread. The team has not decided yet.
input:
#platform channel, export of the thread, 2026-11-13

Thu: we need feature flags with percent rollouts for the invoice export beta. today we only have the env var flags, all or nothing
Huy: three options I see. LaunchDarkly, self-hosted Unleash, or we build a flags table in our own Postgres
Thu: what does LaunchDarkly cost
Huy: sales quoted $1,000 a month for our seat count, email from 2026-11-10
Minh: Unleash is free self-hosted, but it's one more container and it needs its own Postgres database. we are 5 people and I don't want another thing in the on-call rota
Huy: the homegrown table is a week of work maybe, but no percent rollout unless we build it, and no audit log
Thu: audit log matters. SOC 2 auditors asked who changed what flag and when, that's a hard requirement
Minh: so the things that decide it are percent rollout, an audit log for SOC 2, cost, and no new on-call system
Huy: LaunchDarkly has all of that except cost. Unleash has percent rollout, the audit log I'm not sure meets SOC 2, I need to check
Thu: I lean Unleash if the audit log is good enough, LaunchDarkly if not. homegrown is out, too much to build
Minh: agree homegrown is out
Thu: ok write it up as a proposed ADR. Huy checks the Unleash audit log against the SOC 2 list. I decide by 2026-11-28
Minh: anyone want coffee
Huy: yes pls
